name: Preload Script
description: Electron preload script that bridges main and renderer processes via contextBridge. Exposes window.electronAPI with a flat namespace structure (window, clipboard, terminal, workspace, shell, prefs, git, fs, ide). Uses ipcRenderer.invoke for request/response, ipcRenderer.send for fire-and-forget, and ipcRenderer.sendSync for clipboard read. Registers event listeners (terminal:data, terminal:exit, file:changed) that return unsubscribe functions.

namespaces.terminal: create (invoke), write (send), resize (send), kill (send), onData (listener returns unsubscribe), onExit (listener returns unsubscribe)
namespaces.workspace: select (invoke), setPath (invoke), getPath (invoke), load (invoke), save (invoke), getRecent (invoke), addRecent (invoke), removeRecent (invoke)
namespaces.git: remotes (invoke), branches (invoke), checkout (invoke), log (invoke), showTree (invoke), diff (invoke), currentBranch (invoke), stagedFiles (invoke), unstagedFiles (invoke), stagedDiff (invoke), unstagedDiff (invoke), commitBody (invoke), stage (invoke), unstage (invoke), commit (invoke), push (invoke), checkAhead (invoke)
namespaces.fs: readDir (invoke), readFile (invoke), writeFile (invoke), mkdir (invoke), delete (invoke), copy (invoke), rename (invoke), watch (invoke), unwatch (invoke), onChanged (listener returns unsubscribe)

security.nodeIntegration: false — no Node.js APIs exposed to renderer
security.sandbox: false — preload has access to Node.js APIs

lifecycle.created_by: Electron — loaded automatically as preload script on BrowserWindow creation
lifecycle.destroyed_by: BrowserWindow close — preload context destroyed with window
